# convoy Provider

Manage [Convoy](https://www.getconvoy.io) webhooks gateway resources (projects, endpoints, sources, subscriptions, event types and portal links) with Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    convoy = {
      source = "bedis-elacheche/convoy"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from CONVOY_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "convoy" {
  base_url   = "https://us.getconvoy.cloud/api" # or https://eu.getconvoy.cloud/api, or your self-hosted URL
  project_id = var.convoy_project_id            # default project for project-scoped resources
}

variable "convoy_project_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Convoy API key. A project API key can manage resources of its own project; a personal API key is required to manage `convoy_project`. Can also be set via the `CONVOY_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Convoy API, including the `/api` suffix. Defaults to `https://us.getconvoy.cloud/api` (Convoy Cloud US). Use `https://eu.getconvoy.cloud/api` for the EU region or your own host for self-hosted Convoy. Can also be set via the `CONVOY_BASE_URL` environment variable.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries for rate-limited (HTTP 429) and transient gateway errors. Defaults to `3`. Can also be set via the `CONVOY_MAX_RETRIES` environment variable.
- `organisation_id` (String) Default organisation used by `convoy_project`. Can also be set via the `CONVOY_ORGANISATION_ID` environment variable.
- `project_id` (String) Default project for project-scoped resources that do not set `project_id` themselves. Can also be set via the `CONVOY_PROJECT_ID` environment variable.
